notes.title: Amazing Frog? 2 Spring Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/75138058eacff1f120ae79f3f897b772dea0c1de.jpg[/img]

[h2]We were like - "Where are the eggs???"[/h2]

I thought the easter bunny egg hunt would just be there. Nope. So we ran over  the bunny outfit challenge added a few helicopters etc etc. I'll post an event later to explain the "Egg Hunt".

[h3]For now, lets dive into this update.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/4af379747ebabced7ca787f6e4d601c80c05fd73.jpg[/img]

The development of Amazing Frog? 2  is always moving forward. I cannot stress that enough. Every now and then its nice to  do a progressive update that will give you a few extra things to play with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/8abf6c3a17d4d871ceef342dc1c73f85ccff7617.jpg[/img]

As the mechanics evolve so do things which have been there before. When I was testing this update the bunny outfit frogs that spawn in the giant eggs started kicking back after I shot one with an arrow....then i collected the arrow towerfall style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/da212771449b096b0bc402b19b18f61497ffc26b.jpg[/img]

and then of course  its now possible to take their skulls...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ebbe750dae4e3eed0b4a05397fe3d66edb85044a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Looking back... we lose track of what we have been adding, fixing ... er...breaking[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/050e5471b3162e93e2ea9eb55a4ea6f999799cf5.jpg[/img]

We just try and keep moving forward be it enhancing the Frog intelligence (FI) or evolving mechanics,  improving the rendering, adding new content there is no shortage of things to do.

For the past week or so, I have just been at GDC in San Francisco,  being a "game dev" and exploring our future ..  I had the chance to reflect a bit on Amazing Frog? as a whole while I demo-ed it and talked where we want to go ( and about why we are still working on it lol). I got the chance to play with Sandbox and it opened my eyes to the possibilities for the future of Amazing Frog? 2.

We really enjoyed the Dragon update this year and have been ooking at how we can integrate the "Dragon system" as a permanent feature of Amazing Frog ? 2 especially as Hal develops the underwater part of Swindonshire.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/8d25550b588ee624bae8f65a23ff37daf18e72c9.jpg[/img]

For now I am going to go set up a Steam Event so that you guys know how long you have to get the 4 bunny outfits... and make some little videos of the footage I just took, although it may be a bit BMX heavy I got distracted trying to land a flip in the skate park.... Happy Spring Holidays!

notes.title: Amazing Frog? Xmas Sandbox Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ffdf46a1fa230640269e2b3902e8302014bb717a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Welcome to Everything Sandbox.[/h2]
A new category in the menu System called Sandbox. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/790c6df7738d378a9dc92e8c6ee507217b13d5d0.jpg[/img]

Yeah, its literally a Giant Sandbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/2d9e7b747dcdc4f2b04bc4d4d9de5b4cccd38288.jpg[/img]

If you know what a F.A.P.S. ( Fairly Accurate Placement System ) Desk then you will be familiar with how this works in Amazing Frog? 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/b05adc87594d5074a0405fdfa27fb569fadcc5ac.jpg[/img]

The F.A.P.S. Desk came about because we had been developing so many different types of Vehicle, creatures, accessories, weapons etc etc, that we needed to be able to gameplay test them rapidly making different combination. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ebf82057f962c3c30883d7918525181b1e811763.jpg[/img]
 
And while you know we love our unlocks in Amazing Frog? by finding F.A.P.S. Disks  often its nice to just have access to a bunch of content and just place them next to each other and see what happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/72c3acafddf7df8780a881ac5cd8f81b0ca862df.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/0d91ea4beaf6af78d5bf1ea25ab5d154069650d4.jpg[/img]

Sometime in Development the F..A.P.S. Desk has been so helpful... but also really addictive, weird and fun. I have often lost too much time just experimenting with different combos... but I do have all the Disks.
Apart from the giant Sandbox we also have Winter island where the F.A.P.S. desk has a bunch of festive FAPS Disks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/0a983ea5d378362795731b7c2554743392d2f998.jpg[/img]

With these two Sandbox worlds, we have also been creating other worlds for Amazing Frog?2 (Its all part of a larger development plan.) Winter Island is one of these.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f06aa4696034e9f45b1bab97b38665a48f76507d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Visit Tiny Islands[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/1694d75f372425272f8fd1a410ab718a586ee15d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f3e820023d6c0352478837d980462113fae3d19d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/3b0df76863121b8e3c8da388704a5c275725c189.jpg[/img]

[h2]Collect things in the Toy Room[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/93f9420b498e800a12e19219b9db21b63346b990.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/603963d8d287a93cb9e966a2fa71d44b5cb99bde.jpg[/img]

We have a whole bunch of other worlds to come too.

What about Swindon shire?
Well it may run better for many players The main reason I didn't call this a "Major" update in that I know Swindonshire needs more attention and we are very close to a world refresh for Swindonshire in AF?2 but its not quite ready, but we really wanted you to share in the sandbox ness these Holidays.  There have had been some pretty fundamental  physics updates that should help, but we haven't had bunches of time to test so be warned some strange things may well  happen in this update. 

And more to follow very soon.

Hey FAPpy Holidays !
